 Sun TV reports 3% increase in consolidated PAT in Q2’27
 Revenue was down 30% to ₹940 crore (₹1,300 crore); the advertisement revenues for Q2’27 declined to ₹253 crore (₹292 crore); Domestic subscription revenues up 2.34% ₹487 crore
 By BL Chennai Bureau 
 Updated - October 30, 2026 at 06:08 PM. × Share
 WhatsApp X Facebook LinkedIn Messenger Reddit Mail https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/sun-tv-reports-3-increase-in-consolidated-pat-in-q227/article71644802.ece Copy Sun TV Network , the Chennai-based television broadcasters, reported a 3 per cent increase in consolidated net profit to ₹365 crore for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026 as against ₹355 crore in the same quarter last year.
 Revenue was down 30 per cent to ₹940 crore (₹1,300 crore). The advertisement revenues for Q2’27 declined to ₹253 crore (₹292 crore). Domestic subscription revenues up 2.34 per cent ₹487 crore.
 A statement said that SunRisers Leeds records revenues of ₹99 crore.
 The company’s board declared an interim dividend of ₹3.75 per share (75 per cent) on a face value of ₹5 per share.
 The Board also approved the Re-appointment of Kalanithi Maran as Whole Time Director designated as “Executive Chairman” for a period of five years with effect from April 20, 2027.. Similarly, Kavery Kalanithi was also reappointed as Whole Time Director designated as Executive Director for a period of five years with effect from same date.
